notes.title: WoodZone | Devlog #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/efd506da41cd422c31bab3dd18760157500664d7.png[/img][h3]Hello, lumberjacks![/h3]

Currently, we are focused on creating new quests and locations for the WoodZone. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/b3f32c2c68530cb7ef34b75b144532a8473ca680.png[/img]

The game is receiving a whole new story and engaging quests. We want to avoid adding fetch missions for the main story that will require You to cut 50 trees or something similar. Those will still appear as they simply fit the theme but their weight moved to additional quests. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/13b2325c1332372e33c629c6d29e0df2140cac08.png[/img]

The idea is to set our main character on his woodcutting expedition for... something ;) We don't want to spoil too much from the story right now. Gameplay-wise major change is instead of building one enormous woodcutting facility we will run several of them each in different locations with a different set of goals to achieve. By one day we will need to build a bridge, and some complex construction by another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/0c206589479ffc359312d0055ca3b368cb45fffd.png[/img]

The main base isn't going away though. It will become our hub from which we can start new expeditions. Hub itself will contain its own quests and by accomplishing missions we will progress the Main Base development further.

Meanwhile, we have managed to solve most of the issues created by upgrading the Unreal Engine version used for the game. Our animations are back and alive.

Next Devlog in two weeks. Most probably we will talk further about the minigames and quick-time events. 

Stay tuned, Lumberjacks, chopping away.
[i]Desand Game Studios "WoodZone" team[/i]
https://discord.com/invite/p7vdrn8

notes.title: WoodZone | Devlog #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453457/231fe1d61051de5b47fe62b681a95ccf2bd4ff38.png[/img][h3]Hello, lumberjacks![/h3]

It has been a while since our last update, and we would like to share some news, plans and explanations.

[olist]
[*] The game is still under development and will be published.
We haven't abandoned it for a single day.

[*] We are going to post Devlogs regularly from now on.

[*] The game has changed a lot, and we had to change its scope.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/a4bde1e396072290a435949166ad64dd89555b3b.png[/img]

We need a word of explanation here. We had suffered a major delay with the game development due to the Unreal Engine version being used for WoodZone.

Originally it was developed on Unreal Engine 4.14 that caused us some technical issues that a currently used version solved.

Sadly just as much it solves a lot of troubles, it brings just as many new ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/ca48c87e66c6a9cca45a039747c6516d4614de77.png[/img]

With the failure of Kickstarter, we had to change the scope of the game as well.

Originally it was supposed to become a multiplayer sandbox game with a lot of Tycoon-like gameplay.

Currently, the game has become a single-player story-driven game with a lot of Tycoon-like gameplay.

For that purpose, we are doing three things in parallel.

- Fixing Unreal Engine version swap related issues.
- Improving already made stuff while fixing it (mostly graphics)
- Creating new content for the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/a09dd077b92f3a32d94341ea3d52aecaa4f77a4b.png[/img]

Right now, our main concern is to fix animations in the game as soon as we make it, we will be able to show much more from the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/ad8871ea907f956164bd49513d2b051263fbb27d.png[/img]

Next Devlog in two weeks. We will post it every 2 or 3 weeks from now on.

Stay tuned, Lumberjacks, chopping away.
[i]Desand Game Studios "WoodZone" team[/i]

notes.title: (small) Progress Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/c27510944a19a143dc4c9f0453eaf653b8061b11.png[/img]

In recent months, we've worked hard to make the game work as well as possible. We still have a lot of work ahead of us in the future, in terms of physics and content.

I am pleased to announce that the game has moved to the next stage of work, in which we can work on content again. It also means that the Demo version is already close to release and we are now dealing with formalities.

The above graphic presents what WoodZone looks like today. In recent days a lot has changed from the visual side and we can include a new sky with dynamic lighting (cloudy), new grass with interaction and flying animals.

Thank you for your patience and support! We also ask you for a moment of perseverance until the coming "big day", which will be announced by us and our publisher.

Your DeSand Team
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/d63ae34c41fd78c3e6bc84303103167d63ac3223.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33439258/437d8897c41795989fb9a7425deae4a2f6371a27.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
[i]Kickstarter[/i]

After creating several dozen updates with fixes over the past months, we can announce that the current version of WoodZone no longer has known bugs. This means that we are almost ready for the campaign and are still working on small details that will make the game more enjoyable.


[i]Announcement of changes[/i]

With the start of Kickstarter you can expect lots of new information from the world of WoodZone. Among other things, we've redesigned the Steam website, edited the lighting and overall look of the game, and most importantly we've created many new worlds in the game (tundra, jungle, desert, etc.) from which you can expect short previews. 


[i]Full game release[/i]

We are currently at the stage of improving the operation of the multiplayer system and we are working on a dedicated server system thanks to cooperation with ZAP-hosting. The premiere of the game will take place shortly after the end of the Kickstarter campaign and will be developing over the next few (or more) years with further mechanics, i.e. extraction of raw materials, survival mode and hundreds of subsequent building elements. As of today WoodZone has 5 categories of walls, each having many materials and sizes, which gives several hundred models. For this, the player has at his disposal furniture, shelves for arranging objects on them and machines, i.e. conveyor belts and sawmills.
